name: Chino Grande
description: Chino Grande is a vibrant karaoke bar and restaurant that offers a lively and inclusive atmosphere. Known for its creative fusion cuisine and extensive drink menu, it transforms into a karaoke haven every night, especially after 10pm. The venue features a fun, energetic vibe with friendly staff, making it perfect for both casual nights out and private celebrations. Its unique blend of Asian-Latin flavors and lively entertainment sets it apart as a top nightlife spot in Williamsburg.
